benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Axis Bank offers two credit cards in co-branded partnership with Samsung, wherein Samsung Axis Bank Signature is the base variant and Samsung Axis Bank Infinite is the premium variant. Available at an annual fee of Rs. 500, the Signature variant offers 10% flat cashback on Samsung product purchases at physical stores, Samsung eStore or App, including transactions made at Samsung Service Centres and Samsung product purchases via Amazon. Besides, cardholders also get accelerated rewards on some popular brands like BigBasket, Zomato, Myntra and more. Read on to know the detailed features and benefits along with a review.
highlights: 10% cashback on all Samsung purchases (including EMI transactions)
Cashback is directly credited to your credit card statement
Maximum cashback of Rs. 2,500 per month and Rs. 10,000 in a year
10 EDGE Reward Points per Rs. 100 spent on preferred partners – Myntra, Zomato, Urban Company, BigBasket and Tata 1MG
benefits_features_and_faqs.welcome_benefit: Welcome Benefit: 2,500 bonus EDGE Reward Points on making 3 transactions within 30 days of card issuance
milestone_benefits: Fuel Surcharge Waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on spends of Rs. 400 to Rs. 4,000
Fee Waiver: Annual fee of Rs. 500 waived off on spending Rs. 2 Lakh in the preceding year4
dining_benefits: 10 EDGE Reward Points per Rs. 100 spent on preferred partners – Myntra, Zomato, Urban Company, BigBasket and Tata 1MG
10% discount on Swiggy and Amazon Fresh
Saving up to Rs. 500 p.m. on dining
get_this_card_if: You are a loyal customer of Samsung and are planning to purchase several Samsung products
You often shop with the preferred partners like Myntra, Zomato, BigBasket, etc. and can maximize the accelerated rewards structure
You are comfortable getting reward points on spends other than Samsung
You do not travel often and do not seek benefits like travel portal discounts, low forex mark-up, etc.

faqs.q: What is the limit of a Samsung Axis Bank credit card?
faqs.a: Credit limit is determined on the basis of several factors like income, credit history, current debts, etc. and the card issuer’s internal policies. The credit limit on your Samsung Axis Bank Credit Card would be communicated to you on card approval and delivery.

faqs.q: Is Samsung Axis Bank Signature Card worth it?
faqs.a: Samsung Axis Bank Credit Card can be a good choice for those who frequently purchase Samsung products. However, those who do not want to limit their savings to one or more brands but want solid returns on all online spends should consider other cards.

faqs.q: Does Samsung Axis Bank Credit Card offer unlimited cashback?
faqs.a: No, 10% cashback on Samsung spends is capped at Rs. 2,500 per month and Rs. 10,000 per year.

faqs.q: How to activate my Samsung Axis Bank Credit Card?
faqs.a: There are multiple ways to activate your Axis Bank Credit Card including net banking, mobile app, phone banking and ATM. You can also call Axis Bank Customer Care on 1800 209 5577 or 1800 103 5577 to activate your card.

faqs.q: Is there any limit on the rewards earning on Samsung Axis Bank Credit Card?
faqs.a: No. Only cashback on Samsung spends is capped; there is no capping on reward earning on accelerated categories or other spends.
